messages:
tara: Hey all :wave: I'm Tara, started today on infra. Quick access question — I need AWS and GCP access to follow the infra runbooks and debug a staging job. Who should I ask for which roles? I also need to check billing link for the staging project (is that separate?)

devops-bot: Onboarding ticket created: #ONB-4127. Assigned to samuel. Please follow the steps in https://redwood.internal/onboarding.

samuel: welcome Tara! :wave: Short checklist so you can get unblocked: 1) AWS console SSO invite (we use Okta) — check your email. 2) GCP workspace invite (IAM) — you'll get an invite to the org. 3) Billing access is separate (see below).

samuel: For day-to-day: ask for these roles, ideally scoped to the staging accounts/projects, not org-wide. AWS: attach these managed policies on the staging account role: `arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess` + `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/Redwood-DevOps-Temp` (that policy includes ecs, iam pass-role for service accounts, and logs read). If you need to deploy, we'll add `Redwood-Deployers`.

samuel: GCP: request the following bindings on the staging project: `roles/viewer`, `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` (for impersonation), and `roles/logging.viewer`. For billing checks only: `roles/billing.viewer` on the billing account. Avoid `roles/editor` unless we explicitly approve.

samuel: Region permissions — we don't do region-level IAM entries generally. If you need resources only in eu-west-1, mention it and we'll ensure the SSO role's trust allows cross-region use.

samuel: Quick verification commands once you're in:
```
# AWS
aws sts get-caller-identity
# GCP
gcloud config get-value account && gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-staging
```

marta: tagging a couple notes from devex: 1) For billing to show up in the Console you need `roles/billing.viewer` on the billing account (billing account is separate from project IAM). 2) If you need to open cost explorer dashboards, ping finance and we'll add you to the cost view group.

marta: Also, if you will use service accounts on GCP don't create keyfiles — we enforce keyless access. Use `gcloud iam service-accounts impersonate` flow or Workload Identity.

tara: Awesome, thanks. I did get the SSO email for AWS but not GCP yet. I probably need billing.viewer on the staging billing account to see invoices. Who owns that?

samuel: billing account for staging is `billing-RED-DEV-01`. I'll add you as `roles/billing.viewer` there. Can you confirm the email you use for Okta?

tara: tara@redwood.ai — confirmed.

samuel: Added you to the billing account as viewer — should take a few minutes. Reply here when you can see invoices (console -> Billing -> Billing accounts -> billing-RED-DEV-01). :lock:

tara: I can see the billing account now, and I can view invoices. Thanks! :thumbsup:

samuel: Great. Final note: if you need temporary elevated perms for a specific task (eg deploy a stack), file an escalation on the ticket `#ONB-4127` with the justification and duration. We use time-limited role elevation via SSO.

marta: If anything else blocks, ping me in #devex. Also check the docs: https://redwood.internal/cloud-perms (short guide we keep updated).

tara: Will do. Thanks both. One small follow-up: how do I check which region my staging job ran in?

samuel: For ECS/Fargate tasks check the task metadata or CloudWatch logs — region is part of the resource ARNs. For GCP Cloud Run / Cloud Functions, logs show the region in the entry. If you paste the job id here I can point to the log link.

tara: job id `stg-job-2026-03-22-77` — that's from the scheduler.

samuel: Found it, that job ran in us-west-2. Pushed a perm change to allow you read-only there as well.

tara: confirmed I can view the logs now. Thanks again :heart:

devops-bot: ONB-4127 status changed to "In progress" — samuel is working on it.
